reason: Value/transfer lens. The metric arithmetic does not reach the +0.002 public bar, and the lab cannot tell a real gain from noise. (1) Ceiling from the formula. With micro-averaged division J, adding n evaluable forks at precision q changes J by n(q(1+J)-J)/D. With J_pub 0.36 (probe 26, CONTEXT.md 24 Sep 02:00; an UPPER estimate because the zero-fork ablation also drops the second-daughter edges) and D ~50 (GUESS), the change is 0.1 x 5 x 1.36 dq / 50. Probe 35 already ships cap 4 / ens-threshold 0.4 / steal at about break-even precision (0.27; CONF 4/15 added-fork precision). So the retune earns only the precision DIFFERENCE on ~5 evaluable public insertions (3% of insertions are evaluable, 15/466 on CONF, r1_research_div-cap-private-j.json). +0.002 public needs out-of-sample precision to rise from 0.27 to 0.42 (dq 0.15; with 3-4 evaluable, dq 0.18-0.25). A realistic 0.27 -> 0.35 gives +0.0011. The idea's own expected gain is +0.000..+0.002, and its +0.004 upper bound is measured against NO insertion, not against #35. (2) The pre-short-track slot is small. The 13 -> 23 missing-daughter count comes from exp39 tails, not x138 (x138's readmit and gap filler may already restore some). It covers at most 6.6% of GT divisions, about 3 public events. Even at recall 0.4 among those and precision 0.5, it adds +0.0013..+0.0017. At the current 0.27 precision it adds 0. (3) The lab cannot resolve the gain. A CONF delta has SE ~0.0017 (from CI [-0.0007, +0.0050]). The idea's gate of >= +0.001 passes with P = 0.28 when the true effect is 0. A 144-config SELECTION grid (3x3x2x2x2x2) brings a strong winner's curse: history shows v1 orphan +0.0044 -> +0.0010 and steal +0.0058 -> +0.0019. Precision is estimated from ~15 evaluable forks (binomial CI about +-0.2), and 44b6's share of that is 1 TP on 1 video (overlapping crops of one recording, so it effectively counts once). (4) The pool and the precision are in-sample. The x138 detector, the edge network and ILP/relink, which choose v and c1, and the steal gate were trained on all 199 videos. DaughterNet v1 'OOF' folds split within an embryo, not by embryo, so the lab precision is an upper bound for unseen embryos. The v2 cap verdict (cap 4->6: 0 TP / +2 FP) shows that precision falls with rank. Measured transfer of this exact stage: SELECTION -> CONF 33%, CONF -> LB ~50% (+0.0019 -> +0.001). (5) The LB cannot see it. Two probes differ with sd ~0.003 (0.946 / 0.942 byte-identical twins), so a +0.001 change cannot be adopted on evidence; the adoption rule 'not worse than #35 - 0.002' would accept noise. (6) Node multiplier: node-identical apart from the ckpt slot (<= +0.05% nodes -> <= 0.00005 on adj_edge), so this is neither a risk nor a gain. (7) Private: J_priv is probably lower (break-even 0.12-0.20), so existing insertions help more there. But #35's config already captures that. The retune's marginal forks sit lower in the ranking and are judged by an in-sample pool on an unseen embryo: +0.000..+0.001, sign uncertain. (8) The whole line is conditional on #35 >= #34 (unknown until ~17:00-20:00 UTC) and costs 10 GPU-h of friend A / sasyami time for x138 tails. That time competes with anything that can move the edge term (~0.91), where the real loss is.
